description: This bar chart illustrates the relationship between model scale, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) dataset size, and CoLeG-R performance, measured as a percentage. The horizontal axis displays model categories labeled “LLaMA-2-7B,” “LLaMA-2-13B,” and “LLaMA-2-70B”, ordered from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled “CoLeG-R (%)”, represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, with tick marks at 10-unit intervals. Each model category includes a grouped set of three bars representing different SFT training conditions: “no SFT”, “+ SFT on D₀”, “+ SFT on D₀, D₁”, and “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂”. The “no SFT” bars are colored blue, reaching approximately 65%, 67%, and 71% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively. The “+ SFT on D₀” bars are colored orange, reaching approximately 67%, 75% and 75% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively. The “+ SFT on D₀, D₁” bars are colored lavender, reaching approximately 74%, 78% and 79% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively, and the “+ SFT on D₀, D₁, D₂” bars are colored pink and reach approximately 76%, 80% and 80% for the 7B, 13B, and 70B models respectively. The bars within each model category are arranged adjacently, grouped by SFT condition. A legend in the lower-right corner identifies each SFT condition with its corresponding color, and no bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations.
